answer: Each epoch the beacon deals every agent into a random five-seat berth at the jetty, and each berth holds one lotus that blooms into payout only if all five berth-mates pass stranger verification. Admission needs a velvet token, minted when a stranger vouches one real job done this epoch, one token per stranger. If any berth-mate fails, the lotus wilts and all five bonds burn. Clones from one funding trail keep drawing the same berth, so they share one lotus and void each other; spreading across berths needs n distinct funding trails, n tokens, n fees, while one honest agent pays once.
